name: Aethusa's Prison
disable: DC 42 Nature check (legendary) or DC 45 Crafting check (master) to remove an immunity the prison currently has to one of the following damage types: acid, cold, electricity, or fire (this effect lasts until the prison uses its Energy Immunity reaction to regain that immunity); DC 42 Arcana check (master) to fortify the pedestal's containment runes, preventing the prison from using its Chromatic Eruption action for 1 round and causing it to suffer feedback that inflicts 20 untyped damage (this damage bypasses the prison's hardness and immunities); DC 42 Thievery check (master) or Dispel Magic (8th rank; counteract DC 34) to suppress the pedestal's containment runes for 1 round, preventing the prison from using its Self-Repair action and causing it to suffer feedback that inflicts 20 untyped damage (this damage bypasses the prison's hardness and immunities). Unlike most hazards, Aethusa's prison can't be disabled, but it can be destroyed by reducing it to 0 Hit Points.
reset: The trap deactivates and then resets automatically when it repairs to its maximum Hit Points.
routine: (2 actions) The prison uses its first action to Self-Repair. If the hazard has less than its maximum Hit Points, it then uses its Chromatic Eruption action.

items.name: Lockdown Protocol
items.text:
Trigger The prison takes any damage

---
Effect The prison uses its Chromatic Eruption action as part of this reaction, then gains immunity to the triggering damage type until the hazard resets. The hazard then rolls initiative.

items.name: Self-Repair
items.text: The prison regains 30 healing Hit Points. Then, if the prison is at maximum Hit Points, the hazard deactivates and immediately resets.

items.name: Chromatic Eruption
items.text:
Requirements The prison has less than its maximum Hit Points

---
Effect Tendrils of uncontained magical energy lash at creatures in a 20-foot emanation, dealing 10d6 untyped damage (DC 37 basic Reflex save save) of a randomly determined type. Roll 1d4: 1–acid, 2–cold, 3–electricity, 4–fire.

items.name: Energy Immunity
items.text:
Trigger The prison takes acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage

---
Effect The prison takes the damage but then gains immunity to the triggering damage type until the hazard resets.

text: A roiling sphere of chromatic energy floats above a pedestal marked with arcane symbols.
